old_path: Repeated model prefills are treated as ordinary inference cost; F2 has a policy-level cache/reuse metric but no observed canonical provenance/invalidation contract for inference prefix/KV reuse.
proposed_research_path: Define a thin runtime-neutral ModelPrefixCacheIdentity/v1 plus InferencePrefixReuseReceipt/v1 research contract. Do not import vLLM/SGLang/llama.cpp as architecture and do not persist physical KV bytes as canonical state.
minimum_semantic_identity: exact model/checkpoint identity at the strongest available consumed-artifact scope
exact reusable prefix token identity or chained prefix digest
adapter/LoRA/control-vector/J-Space control-state identity when it can alter KV semantics
multimodal/prompt-embedding identity and offsets when present
privacy/isolation namespace represented by a non-secret namespace digest or runtime cache_salt binding
runtime_compatibility_identity: inference engine/runtime class and build identity where needed for safe reuse
KV layout/attention backend/dtype/block or cache-format version where the runtime requires exact compatibility
loader/model-generation lease identity only when reuse across reload/generation boundaries is not explicitly proven safe

source_to_f2_mapping.external_mechanism: vLLM chained block identity + extra keys + cache_salt
source_to_f2_mapping.distilled_f2_lesson: Token-prefix equality alone is insufficient whenever adapters, multimodal content, prompt embeddings or isolation boundaries alter execution semantics; F2 cache identity must include every semantically KV-affecting non-token input.

source_to_f2_mapping.external_mechanism: SGLang RadixKey extra_key/cache_salt and session soft references
source_to_f2_mapping.distilled_f2_lesson: Separate cache namespace/compatibility from conversation/session truth; session affinity may influence eviction only and cannot become memory reconstruction.
Runtime cache mechanisms can remain engine-owned; F2 should standardize identity/receipt/invalidation evidence rather than duplicate the physical cache implementation.
Potential reuse beyond exact prefix is a separate mechanism class with additional semantic and integrity risk and therefore requires an independent claim/falsification lane before consideration.

counterhypothesis: Real F2 ContextViews may change on almost every cycle because state, retrieval, goals, perception and evidence deltas alter early prompt tokens. Exact-prefix reuse may therefore be too small to justify cache identity, isolation, memory overhead and invalidation complexity.

cheapest_high_information_discriminator.name: F2_PREFIX_REUSE_TRACE_ABLATION_DESIGN/v1
procedure: Collect or derive a representative set of exact F2 model-call rendered prompts/token streams at the normal evidence boundary without enabling a KV cache.
Compute per-call longest reusable exact prefix under candidate semantic identity partitions, including cold, same-session and isolation-boundary-separated cases.
Measure reusable-prefix-token distribution and theoretical prefill-work ceiling before adding runtime code.
Reject the candidate if reuse is negligible or key instability dominates.
Only if reuse is material, hand a later bounded Trigger-4 A/B plan to target runtime: cache disabled vs enabled with exact request/model/runtime identity and invariant-equivalent outputs.

Negative invalidation tests must mutate tokenizer/template, prefix tokens, adapter/control state, multimodal identity, model/runtime compatibility and isolation namespace and require MISS/fail-closed behavior.
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.acceptance_to_continue_research: Observed representative F2 traces demonstrate nontrivial exact-prefix reuse under a provenance-safe identity partition and no evidence that reuse requires treating cache state as canonical memory/truth.
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.rejection: Reuse ceiling is negligible, provenance identity is unstable/unavailable, isolation cannot be guaranteed, or invalidation semantics cannot be bound exactly.
